verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the Entity Management and other public APIs: a section on API key rate limits and a 1,000,000-record cap on returned results. Nothing documents operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts for the online entity-registration flow a founder would use. API rate limits are an adjacent control on a different surface and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
